Heteroscedasticity diagnostic theme

Source: R/ggplot_extensions.R
theme_hetero.Rd

Applies a light-minimal theme with subtle gridlines and bold titles to maintain visual consistency across diagnostic plots.

Usage

theme_hetero(base_size = 12, base_family = "")

Arguments

base_size

Base font size.

base_family

Base font family.

Value

A ggplot2::theme object.

Examples

theme_hetero()
#> <theme> List of 144
